thread.title: Facebook to design its own chips as part of hardware push

author: Deepa Seetharaman
title: Facebook to design its own chips as part of hardware push
text:
Facebook Inc. is planning to design chips that could be used in its consumer devices, artificial-intelligence software and data centers, according to a person familiar with the matter and recent job listings.
The effort is part of the social-media company’s nascent push to develop more of its own hardware.
The project to design custom chips, still in its early stages, could give Facebook FB, -1.36% greater control over the design and development of its various hardware projects under way, which include connected speakers and virtual-reality headsets, the person said.
Other tech giants have gone the same route, including Alphabet Inc.’s GOOGL, -0.37% GOOG, -0.19% Google, which developed its own microprocessor chips to advance its work in artificial intelligence, search ranking and other features. In 2009, Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.22% launched its own chip-making effort to boost the power and efficiency of its devices.
